title.narrative: Minamata Initial Assessment and National Action Plan for the ASGM sector in Nicaragua

description.narrative: Through this project, the country will undertake two interventions contributing to the implementation of the Minamata Convention: (i) Minamata Initial Assessment (MIA), and (ii) National Action Plan (NAP) for the artisanal and small-scale gold mining sector in accordance with Annex C of the Convention.
